issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care issue for representing improving, deteriorating, and no-change condition course. The final resolution added ClinicalImpression.changePattern after ClinicalImpression.problem, cardinality 0..1, CodeableConcept type, example binding, and SNOMED CT example codes for worsening, improving, and no status change.
initial_application: Commit 705001a8305b39afe7a4d59f41055a0f212b301d (J#36197 ClinicalImpression.changePattern) added the requested ClinicalImpression.changePattern element and clinicalimpression-change-pattern value set. The commit is contained in v5.0.0, and the current checkout retains the R5-era source showing the requested element and codes.
additional_context: FHIR-46596 later renamed ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment for R6, and commit 670d3a407a962cdde0ef1136fbcdea045b124f19 carried changePattern forward in the renamed resource. Commit fad1b9cf84ef652e88947e1a13b026c62f95334e then removed ClinicalAssessment from active core fhir.ini resource lists and changed core narrative links to the PC incubator IG. The PC incubator ClinicalAssessment JSON currently includes changePattern with the same definition, cardinality, binding, and SNOMED CT example codes. Confluence and Zulip evidence supports the original Patient Care conclusion and did not reveal a conflicting final decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is needed because the approved R5 change is already present historically, the renamed ClinicalAssessment carried it forward, and the active current artifact is outside the core build and already exposes the same semantics.
